reply_text: Sofia, it was **Pellow**, not Pellucid. Kwame and you settled it in #coastal-team on Feb 17: the lamp delivery at door 6 was on your retail account, which had just been renamed from Covey & Lark Retail to Pellow Home Living. The "PHL" code is shared with Pellucid Harbor Logistics, which is why the two got mixed up.
